stem.text: A student was presented with a photomicrograph of a cell organelle. The magnification of the photomicrograph is known.
Which calculation of the actual length of the organelle in $\mu\text{m}$ is correct?

A.text: actual size in $\text{cm} \times 100$ divided by the magnification

B.text: actual size in $\text{mm} \times 100$ divided by the magnification

C.text: image size in $\text{cm} \times 1000$ divided by the magnification

D.text: image size in $\text{mm} \times 1000$ divided by the magnification
